profiles.name: query-with-signatures
profiles.retained_capability: Read compact blocks and metadata, resolve keys and block hashes, and read transaction signatures
profiles.omitted_capability: PoH and shredding evidence are not available in this cloud copy; optional serving payloads must be rebuilt or fetched separately

profiles.name: query-without-signatures
profiles.retained_capability: Scan compact block messages and metadata and resolve keys and block hashes
profiles.omitted_capability: Cloud copy cannot supply transaction signature bytes or PoH/shredding evidence; signature-dependent consumers need another source

profiles.name: all-compact-files
profiles.retained_capability: All stored Compact V2 files and supporting records

important_distinction: Base reader admission is not proof of complete ledger data, full epoch coverage, or a full signed transaction service.
